WELCOME_ATTRACT.text: Barka da zuwa. Don Allah ku matso gaba don fara zaɓe.

SELECT_LANGUAGE.text: Don Allah ku zaɓi harshenku. Ku nuna harshenku sannan ku tsaya.

LANGUAGE_CONFIRMED.text: An zaɓi harshe. Bari mu fara.

FACE_AUTH_INSTRUCTIONS.text: Don Allah ku dubi kamara kuma ku ƙyaftawa yadda aka saba.

FACE_AUTH_LIVENESS_RETRY.text: Ba mu iya tabbatar da kasancewarku ba. Don Allah ku dubi kamara ku sake ƙyaftawa.

FACE_AUTH_FAIL.text: Ba mu iya gane ku ba. Don Allah ku ga jami'in rajista.

FACE_AUTH_AMBIGUOUS.text: Ba mu iya tabbatar da ainihin ku ba da tabbaci. Don Allah ku nemi taimako daga jami'i.

ALREADY_VOTED.text: Bayaninmu ya nuna kun riga kun kada kuri'a. Mun gode.

FACE_AUTH_SUCCESS.text: An tabbatar da ainihin ku. Bari mu fara kuri'ar ku.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_PRESIDENT.text: Ku nuna jam'iyyar da kuka zaɓa domin Shugaban Ƙasa, sannan ku tsaya.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_GOVERNOR.text: Ku nuna jam'iyyar da kuka zaɓa domin Gwamna, sannan ku tsaya.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_SENATE.text: Ku nuna jam'iyyar da kuka zaɓa domin Sanata, sannan ku tsaya.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_HOR.text: Ku nuna jam'iyyar da kuka zaɓa domin Dan Majalisar Wakilai, sannan ku tsaya.

OFFICE_INSTRUCTIONS_SHA.text: Ku nuna jam'iyyar da kuka zaɓa domin Dan Majalisar Dokoki ta Jiha, sannan ku tsaya.

SELECTION_CONFIRM_PROMPT.text: Ku tsaya kuma don tabbatarwa, ko ku nuna canja don zaɓar wata jam'iyyar.

REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS.text: Ga takardar kuri'ar ku. Ku duba zaɓinku kafin mikawa.

REVIEW_EDIT_PROMPT.text: Ku nuna kowane ofis don canza zaɓinku.

SUBMIT_CONFIRM_PROMPT.text: Ku tsaya kan mikawa don kada kuri'ar ku. Ba za a iya sokewa ba bayan haka.

SUBMIT_SUCCESS.text: An kada kuri'ar ku cikin nasara.

SUBMIT_FAILED_RETRY.text: Wani abu ya faru yayin mikawa kuri'ar ku. Don Allah ku tsaya kan sake gwadawa.

THANK_YOU.text: Mun gode da kuka kada kuri'a. Don Allah ku ba da dama ga mai zabe na gaba.

TIMEOUT_WARNING.text: Ko kuna nan? Wannan zama zai ƙare ba da jimawa ba.

SESSION_RESET.text: Zama ya ƙare. Muna komawa farko.

ERROR_GENERIC.text: Wani abu ya faru. An sanar da jami'i.
